title: Show HN: Maple-Preview – Ternary 20B MoE running at 120 tok/s on a iPhone
summary: Maple-Preview is a ternary 20B Mixture of Experts LLM that achieves 120 tokens per second inference speed on iPhone, making large language model deployment on mobile devices practical without cloud dependency.
problem_solved: Enables running large 20B parameter language models locally on resource-constrained mobile devices like iPhones with acceptable performance.
why_valuable: Brings privacy-preserving, offline AI capabilities to mobile devices while demonstrating extreme model compression through ternary quantization techniques.
